title: Saltglass Cavern: The Historian's Resonance Tablet
premise: In a crystalline underworld cut by migratory subterranean rivers, the historian must recover lost testimony without rewriting it using a chronicle decoding slate.
ending: Recover the Resonance Tablet and return with the unaltered historical account; Cavern Chorus can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive shard bloom while evading the mineral sentinel without sacrificing the unaltered historical account.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Cavern Chorus to witness the chronicle decoding slate.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to reveal a compromising record
